name: Kelpweave Galleries
introDiscord:
Sheets of kelp-silk stretch between the roots like tapestries.
Kelpweave Spiders move across them with impossible grace, turning the
forest into equal parts gallery and web.
introTwitch:
Sheets of kelp-silk stretch between the roots like tapestries.
Kelpweave Spiders move across them with impossible grace, turning the
forest into equal parts gallery and web.

kelpweave-galleries-approach.prompt:
Three routes pass beneath woven scenes of moons, fish, travelers, and
several suspiciously accurate depictions of people getting stuck.

left.message:
One Berry hangs inside a small silk pouch beside Shizuki's note:

'Spider made bag.

Excellent craftsmanship.

Bag attached to wall.

Design flaw.'

right.message:
A shrine coffer has been wrapped in decorative kelp-silk. Opening it
reveals Star Candies beneath a beautifully woven lid.

Five-star packaging.

forward.message:
A tapestry depicting a Spider shifts.

The Spider steps out of its own portrait.

Okay, that was impressive.

kelpweave-galleries-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp columns support three gallery walks suspended on woven
bridges.

left.message:
A Kelpweave Spider races across a thread too thin to see.

You notice the web only when the Spider is already standing in front of
you.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beneath a little silk canopy.

Shizuki wrote:

'Spider built roof over my camp.

Did not ask.

Still grateful.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched beneath Shizuki's professionally installed
spider roof.

forward.message:
An offering basket has been woven into the gallery wall. Inside are
Star Candies surrounded by a silk border shaped like tiny stars.

kelpweave-galleries-threshold.prompt:
Living roots converge on Tide-Silk Rotunda. Three final approaches hang
between enormous layered tapestries.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp hides a Star Candy bundle behind an unfinished
tapestry.

The missing section appears to be shaped exactly like you.

Unsettling artistic process.

right.message:
A Kelpweave Spider descends upside down on one silver thread.

It pauses at eye level.

Then chooses violence.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'For web-related falls.

There were several.

No further questions.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the fall medicine untouched and avoid reviewing Shizuki's
incident history.

boss-antechamber.name: Tide-Silk Rotunda
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every woven bridge in the Rotunda tightens simultaneously.

bossPromptDiscord:
The enormous tapestries pull upward like curtains.

At their center hangs a web spanning the entire Tide-Silk Rotunda.

Something vast moves across it without making a single strand tremble.

Use /yes to enter the Rotunda or /no to leave the master weaver's
gallery untouched.
bossPromptTwitch:
The enormous tapestries pull upward like curtains.

At their center hangs a web spanning the entire Tide-Silk Rotunda.

Something vast moves across it without making a single strand tremble.

Use !yes to enter the Rotunda or !no to leave the master weaver's
gallery untouched.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw beneath the hanging tapestries. The enormous web remains
perfectly still behind you.

boss.revealText:
Silver threads snap taut as a colossal Spider descends into the
Rotunda.

Moonloom Weaver reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Moonloom Weaver retreats into the highest web.

The smaller Spiders immediately begin repairing the gallery.

One is already weaving the battle.

Your likeness is questionable."
